svg.title: Driver Dreamer — Scarlet Ribbon — Transparent Header
svg.desc: A finished automotive editorial website pairs a giant single-line CHASE THE FEELING headline with a sharp red typographic ribbon. The circuit photograph remains untinted and the Ferrari hood, interior and wheels remain unobstructed. Direct transparent logos, a white outlined discovery action, a white vehicle rail and one white editorial collection section continue the original navy, red and white identity. The red footer includes legal pages, copyright and a linked Piratechs credit.
